about.title: Petaluma Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Petaluma's 2025 crash data shows 193 injury collisions and 252 people hurt on city roads, with Fridays between 3 and 5 p.m. seeing a noticeable rise in reported incidents. Corridors like E Washington Street, N Mcdowell Boulevard, US-101, and S Mcdowell Boulevard carry heavy daily traffic between downtown, the Petaluma River area, and Highway 101 interchanges, and that volume shows up in the local collision counts. If you were injured in one of these crashes, what happens in the days right after matters. Insurance adjusters often reach out quickly, sometimes before you've even seen a doctor, and a recorded statement given too early can complicate a claim later. LawProactive doesn't practice law or charge any fee to connect you. We simply put you in touch with an independent attorney in the Petaluma area who can look at what happened, explain your options under California law, and help you decide what to do next.

items.title: Time Limits Apply
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the crash date to file a lawsuit, but claims against a government entity — such as a city road defect near Mcdowell Boulevard — may require formal notice in as little as six months. Getting connected early helps preserve that window.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Automatically Sink Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover compensation even if you're found partly responsible for the crash; your share of fault simply reduces the amount. An attorney can help make sure fault is assessed fairly, not just assumed.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering, No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no upfront cost to explore your options.

items.question: I was in a crash on US-101 near Petaluma. What should I do about the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally wise to avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer before speaking with an attorney, since early statements can be used to minimize your claim. Get medical care first, document the scene and vehicle damage if you can, and let an attorney handle communications going forward. LawProactive can connect you with someone who does this regularly.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a Petaluma car accident?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives you two years from the date of the crash to file a lawsuit. If a government entity, like the City of Petaluma, may be responsible — for example due to a road design issue — the notice deadline can be as short as six months, so it's best not to wait.

items.question: Does it cost anything to use LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people with independent attorneys, and it's not a law firm itself. Attorneys in the network typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation.
